subject: geography
topicName: Urban Growth in LICs and NEEs

steps.title: Key Facts
steps.body: Lagos is a megacity in Nigeria, West Africa. It is built on the coast of the Gulf of Guinea and on islands in Lagos Lagoon. With a population of approximately 15 million (metropolitan area), it is the largest city in sub-Saharan Africa and Nigeria's economic capital. Lagos grows by an estimated 77 people per hour.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Lagos was a small town of approximately 300,000 in 1950. By 2025, the metropolitan population is approximately 15 million - a 50-fold increase in 75 years. Projections suggest it could reach 25 million by 2035.

steps.title: Exam Tip
steps.body: When assessing urban planning, always evaluate whether strategies benefit ALL residents or just the wealthy. Eko Atlantic is often criticised for ignoring the needs of the 60% who live in slums. The best answers show understanding of inequality in urban planning.

steps.title: Geography Exam Tips — Urban Growth in LICs and NEEs
steps.body: 1. For Urban Growth in LICs and NEEs questions, always name specific case studies with factual detail 2. Use geographical terminology precisely (e.g. specific processes, not vague descriptions) 3. Consider social, economic and environmental perspectives in your evaluations 4. Support your points about Urban Growth in LICs and NEEs with data, statistics or named examples 5. For 'assess' or 'evaluate' questions, reach a clear judgement supported by evidence

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.body: Explain why Lagos has grown so rapidly. (4 marks) | Describe two challenges of urban growth in a named LIC or NEE city. (4 marks) | Using a named example, assess the opportunities and challenges of urban growth in LICs and NEEs. (6 marks)
